title: The Family Computer
desc: Your parents finally caved and bought a shared desktop. You've been sneaking on it after homework, queueing ranked until 2AM.

success.result: Your hours climb fast. The practice pays off.

failure.result: You burn out quickly, exhausted in class the next day.

choices.label: Study VODs of the pros instead

success.result: You start seeing rotations before they happen.

failure.result: You overcomplicate your reads and second-guess yourself in-game.

title: A 1v1 Clutch Situation
desc: The round comes down to you. The enemy is holding the site. Do you dry peek or try to fake the defuse/plant?

success.result: Your crosshair placement was perfect. You snap to their head and clutch the round!

failure.result: You whiff the first bullet and get punished immediately.

success.result: You flush them out with a perfectly placed flash and secure the round safely.

failure.result: You misread their position, throw a bad flash, and run out of time.
